preview: I am currently in the third year of a Software Engineering and Information Systems degree at GFI University – École Polytechnique de Sousse, and I would like to complete my final-year internship with your team.
paragraphs: I am currently in the third year of a Software Engineering and Information Systems degree at GFI University – École Polytechnique de Sousse, and I would like to complete my final-year internship with your team. My academic background gives me a solid foundation in web and backend development, UML modelling, relational databases and the design of information systems.

My interest in artificial intelligence has led me to work on projects where data serves concrete use cases. During an eight-week internship at Matrixcel Business, I helped design a personalised recommendation platform based on browsing behaviour, building a secure Spring Boot backend, a multilingual React interface and a Python/Flask service integrating machine learning models.

I work with React, Spring Boot, Java and SQL Server, and I am comfortable across the full software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment. The Smart Context AI project illustrates this approach: an intelligent assistant project focused on using context to deliver more relevant interactions, reflecting my interest in practical and concrete AI applications.

Motivated, rigorous and curious, I am now looking for a team where I can apply these skills to real projects and learn from experienced developers. An internship within your organisation would allow me to contribute concretely, adopt your engineering practices and give a professional dimension to my final-year project.
closing: Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to share my CV or discuss my motivation in more detail.
